decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display draws directly on the firm's core cardboard display expertise and in-house R&D, so it can keep refining it even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a core format built on existing knowledge and production capacity, so it remains easy to absorb feedback and maintain.
The eighth-pallet display is a familiar format scaled to smaller placements, and the firm's existing know-how lets it keep serving customers efficiently.
Wood lies further from the firm's paper-based knowledge base, which limits learning, but the pallet still supports the one-stop offer, so it is kept under closer scrutiny.
